item.tib: rig 'dzin chen po stong rgyang mthu chen gyi sngon 'gro thar lam them skas
item.coloph: ces sgrib gnyis sbyang zhing tshogs gnyis bsags pa'i bon spyod 'di yang / skye ba sngon dang da lta 'brel ba'i ldong btsun shes rab phun phun tshogs kyis/ dar dkar dri med chun po dang rin chen gnyis pa'i 'khor lo la/ rten 'brel rtags kyi ri mo bkra ba sogs dang*/ sgo gsum gus pas mtshams sbyar nas/ rin po che yi gter rdol ba dang gter tshol ba 'phrad pa ltar/ skabs su babs pa'i drung mu'i ming can bdag la gangs la mtsho lung dbyar sgar du brgyud pa'o/ nyes 'gal ci mchis rig 'dzin mkha' 'gror bshags/ dge bas 'gro kun byang chub sa thob shog/
